decisive_items: Hematoxylin-eosin stain showed focal epidermal and subepidermal necrosis with numerous filamentous bacilli with septa
Gram stain revealed numerous gram-variable rods in the necrotic epidermis and dermis
response.rationale: The presence of gram-variable rods and filamentous bacilli with septa in the necrotic epidermis and dermis is more specific to ecthyma gangrenosum, a characteristic skin lesion of Pseudomonas aeruginosa infection, than to Pseudomonas aeruginosa infection alone.

rejected.why: Lack of specificity to the skin lesion
